scientific_integrity: Finite verifier checks exact sums and Gram determinants in bounded orders. General asymptotics and component laws are justified by an analytic proof; these are not finite computation claims. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact expectations hold for integers n>=r>=3. Asymptotics and annealed component-size limits assume fixed r>=3 as n tends to infinity; no claim of concentration of individual intrinsic volumes, growing-r uniformity, or unweighted edge-cut component laws. Bibliographic comparisons support but do not establish exhaustive novelty. Prior general Gibbs coefficient methods are acknowledged.
title: Critical logarithmic intrinsic volumes of Cayley-tree graphical zonotopes
